title: Astrid and the Terminal
author: Coral Nystrom
blurb: Rosalind Eastwick, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
